title: Tidy the settled-report retention: a real-turn test step that can't fail, and 'settled' used wider than the code
outcome: The real-turn retention test claims only what it shows, and the adapter doc says which reports are bounded in the code's own terms.
acceptance: ordinary_turns_past_the_retention_send_each_report_once_and_keep_only_the_newest no longer has a step that can't fail: either the 'worker run' step goes and the doc comment narrows, or it calls the worker directly and states that it finds no candidate.
The adapter doc's lead sentence on retention says 'answered definitively' or 'discharged' rather than 'settled', since is_settled also covers a LocalFailure report, which isn't bounded.
